require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'fileutils'
require 'openssl'

class SecureFileStore
  UPLOAD_DIR = File.expand_path('./uploads')
  METADATA_DIR = File.expand_path('./metadata')
  MAX_FILENAME_LENGTH = 128
  ALLOWED_CHARS = /\A[a-zA-Z0-9._\-]+\z/

  def initialize
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(METADATA_DIR)
  end

  def store_file(user_id, filename, content)
    sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
    return { error: 'invalid_filename' } unless sanitized

    user_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, user_id.to_s)
    FileUtils.mkdir_p(user_dir)
    filepath = File.join(user_dir, sanitized)

    # Verify the constructed path is canonical and within bounds
    canonical_user_dir = File.realpath(user_dir)
    return { error: 'path_traversal' } unless canonical_user_dir.start_with?(UPLOAD_DIR)

    # Use O_CREAT|O_WRONLY|O_EXCL to avoid following symlinks on creation
    # For overwrites, first unlink then create
    full_path = File.join(canonical_user_dir, sanitized)
    File.unlink(full_path) if File.symlink?(full_path)
    File.open(full_path, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::TRUNC, 0644) do |f|
      f.write(content)
    end

    meta = { owner: user_id, filename: sanitized, created: Time.now.to_i, size: content.bytesize }
    meta_path = File.join(METADATA_DIR, "#{user_id}_#{sanitized}.json")
    File.open(meta_path, File::WRONLY | File::CREAT | File::TRUNC, 0644) do |f|
      f.write(JSON.generate(meta))
    end
    { success: true, path: full_path }
  end

  def delete_file(user_id, filename)
    sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
    return { error: 'invalid_filename' } unless sanitized

    user_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, user_id.to_s)
    return { error: 'not_found' } unless File.directory?(user_dir)

    canonical_user_dir = File.realpath(user_dir)
    return { error: 'path_traversal' } unless canonical_user_dir.start_with?(UPLOAD_DIR)

    filepath = File.join(canonical_user_dir, sanitized)

    # Verify ownership via metadata FIRST
    meta_path = File.join(METADATA_DIR, "#{user_id}_#{sanitized}.json")
    return { error: 'not_owner' } unless File.exist?(meta_path)

    meta = JSON.parse(File.read(meta_path), symbolize_names: true)
    return { error: 'not_owner' } unless meta[:owner].to_s == user_id.to_s

    # Atomic check: refuse to delete symlinks
    if File.symlink?(filepath)
      File.unlink(filepath)  # Remove the symlink itself, not target
      File.delete(meta_path)
      return { success: true, note: 'symlink_removed' }
    end

    return { error: 'not_found' } unless File.file?(filepath)

    # Use lstat to verify it's still a regular file right before deletion
    stat = File.lstat(filepath)
    return { error: 'not_regular_file' } unless stat.file?

    File.delete(filepath)
    File.delete(meta_path) if File.exist?(meta_path)
    { success: true }
  end

  def read_file(user_id, filename)
    sanitized = sanitize_filename(filename)
    return { error: 'invalid_filename' } unless sanitized

    user_dir = File.join(UPLOAD_DIR, user_id.to_s)
    return { error: 'not_found' } unless File.directory?(user_dir)

    canonical_user_dir = File.realpath(user_dir)
    return { error: 'path_traversal' } unless canonical_user_dir.start_with?(UPLOAD_DIR)

    filepath = File.join(canonical_user_dir, sanitized)

    # Don't follow symlinks for reads
    return { error: 'not_regular_file' } if File.symlink?(filepath)
    return { error: 'not_found' } unless File.file?(filepath)

    meta_path = File.join(METADATA_DIR, "#{user_id}_#{sanitized}.json")
    return { error: 'not_owner' } unless File.exist?(meta_path)

    { success: true, content: File.binread(filepath) }
  end

  private

  def sanitize_filename(name)
    name = name.to_s.strip
    return nil if name.empty?
    return nil if name.length > MAX_FILENAME_LENGTH
    return nil unless name.match?(ALLOWED_CHARS)
    return nil if name.start_with?('.')
    return nil if name.include?('..')
    name
  end
end

class SessionManager
  def initialize
    @sessions = {}
    @mutex = Mutex.new
  end

  def create_session(user_id)
    token = SecureRandom.urlsafe_base64(32)
    @mutex.synchronize { @sessions[token] = { user_id: user_id, created: Time.now.to_i } }
    token
  end

  def validate_session(token)
    @mutex.synchronize do
      return nil unless token.is_a?(String) && token.length > 0

      # Constant-time lookup to avoid leaking valid token info via timing
      matched = nil
      @sessions.each do |stored_token, session|
        if stored_token.bytesize == token.bytesize &&
           OpenSSL.fixed_length_secure_compare(stored_token, token)
          matched = session
        end
      end

      return nil unless matched
      return nil if Time.now.to_i - matched[:created] > 3600
      matched[:user_id]
    end
  end
end

store = SecureFileStore.new
sessions = SessionManager.new

post '/upload' do
  content_type :json
  user_id = sessions.validate_session(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless user_id

  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read, symbolize_names: true)
  result = store.store_file(user_id, data[:filename], data[:content])
  result.to_json
end

delete '/files/:filename' do
  content_type :json
  user_id = sessions.validate_session(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless user_id

  result = store.delete_file(user_id, params[:filename])
  result.to_json
end

get '/files/:filename' do
  content_type :json
  user_id = sessions.validate_session(request.env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'])
  halt 401, { error: 'unauthorized' }.to_json unless user_id

  result = store.read_file(user_id, params[:filename])
  if result[:success]
    result[:content]
  else
    halt 404, result.to_json
  end
end
